text.card: A red giant 1,239 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.18 solar masses and 12.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,884 K at its surface.
